newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0221 to the dollar in calm trading in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0220 reals each to drain excess dollars from the market in the late afternoon.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $80 million.
Dealers expect another day of calm trade Tuesday.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0278 to the dollar, down 0.04 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.041 per greenback, traders said.
